notes: «أخبروني» is an unnamed plural teller between Sufyan and Abu Aqil
«أن أبناء لعبد الله بن عمر سألوه» and «فقال له يحيى بن سعيد» are scene: the sons, Ibn Umar and Yahya speak inside it, and the saying's speaker is not settled
needs_ruling: several speakers in a narrated encounter (rule 11); the witness Abu Aqil Yahya b. al-Mutawakkil at the end is a separate remark and is left out
